integrity: The compactness and absence of finite Schatten membership were already known. The new claim is only the sharp logarithmic singular-value coefficient and equivalent counting rate. Numerical checks are finite corroboration, not proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The exact asymptotic holds for finite Dirichlet polynomial symbols on Hilbert H^2 of Dirichlet series; no claim for general infinite symbols, Banach p, or weighted spaces. An older general multiplier theorem could imply it under another formulation.
title: Sharp logarithmic approximation numbers for Dirichlet-series Volterra operators
